name: GW-501516

protocolDosing.notes: CARCINOGENICITY WARNING: multi-organ cancers in 2-year rodent studies at human-equivalent doses; GSK halted development 2007; WADA issued safety warning

effects: CRITICAL: multi-organ carcinogenicity in rodent studies (liver, stomach, bladder, skin, tongue, testes, ovaries)

mechanismOfAction.summary: Selective PPARδ agonist (EC50 ~1.2 nM); upregulates fatty acid oxidation genes and increases endurance. NOT a SARM.
mechanismOfAction.description: Peroxisome proliferator-activated receptor delta (PPARδ/PPARβ) agonist; does not bind the androgen receptor. Upregulates genes for fatty acid oxidation and mitochondrial biogenesis. Human PK is sparse — GSK discontinued development in 2007 due to multi-organ carcinogenicity in 2-year rodent studies at human-equivalent doses. WADA issued a specific safety warning.
